goal.description: Convert exactly one named MIMIC-IV concept to MIMIC-on-FHIR. Run `/goal <concept>` in a fresh dedicated OpenCode session; interrupted conversions may resume from another fresh session. No next concept is started automatically.

mimic-fhir.description: Upstream MIMIC-on-FHIR ETL. `sql/*.sql` is the citable source for an upstream transformation-loss finding: the judge and the diagnostician must name file and line there before attributing a divergence upstream.

orchestration-new.description: Proven agentic pipeline architecture: Pathling client adapter, ViewDefinition provisioning scripts (sofa_provisioning), config templates, and protocol patterns.

paper_reproductions.description: Proven auto-repro loop pattern, convergence judge separation, HPC transfer/poll skills (csiro-hpc, hpc-transfer), MIMIC_NOTES.md dataset quirks.
